title: Breaking in; movie theater lobby realness; conspiracy theories; the other side of reality
content: In some dreams, I am driving or being driven to some kind of facility. It's nighttime. The vibe is that I'm supposed to be breaking into said facility, or otherwise gaining access to it. Something about a fire? In other dreams, I'm standing in the parking lot or in the general outdoor vicinity of a mall or some other large structure. When I'm indoors, I distinctly remember a large movie theater-like setting, bright colors, neon, almost like an arcade but definitely more like the lobby of a massive movie theater with a jazzy purple rug pattern. And I try to find the edges. Walking where no one else is. Going to the back of the mall. Past the stores where few people shop. Where few people go. Outdoors, daylight, walking up some kind of ramp along the building. I get the impression there is an ocean near me in the distance. In general, IRL, I am fascinated with the industrial underground structures presented in the Jordan Peele film "Us" -- when the main character descends into this world, finding the surreal mall-like setting from her ordinary world, *remembering it* as she goes...this resonates with me. Sometimes it feels like a school. Sometimes it feels like a gathering. A plan. I feel....that there is another side to (this) reality.
